name: TOB Website Settings
description: Settings for the public truthofbible.org website, read by truth_of_bible.api.website. Contact form messages are saved as TOB Website Enquiry and emailed to the recipients below. The web Bible reads the database at Bible Database Path.

fields.label: Contact Form Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses that receive every contact form message, one per line or comma separated. Replying to the email replies to the sender.

fields.label: Confirmation Subject
fields.default: We received your message — Truth of Bible

fields.label: Confirmation Message
fields.default:
Dear {{ full_name }},

Thank you for reaching out to Truth of Bible Ministries. Our team has received your message and will pray with you and reply soon.

“I will not forget you.” — Isaiah 49:15

Truth of Bible Ministries

fields.label: Bible Database Path
fields.description: The read-only database built by truth_of_bible/bible_web/build.py. Relative paths are inside this site's folder.

fields.label: About
fields.options: Which versions appear on the website is set in truth_of_bible/bible_web/catalogue.json (web: true/false, with each licence). Rebuild the database after changing it.
